256.title: What Daniel 1; Daniel 2; Daniel 3 teaches us about God
summary: Daniel and his friends were taken away from their home in Judah and brought to Babylon. Even though they were surrounded by a different culture and were expected to live like the Babylonians, Daniel chose to honor God. God gave Daniel and his friends wisdom, understanding, and favor as they remained faithful to Him.

Later, King Nebuchadnezzar had a troubling dream and demanded that his wise men tell him both the dream and its meaning. No one could do it, but Daniel prayed with his friends and God revealed the mystery to him. Daniel explained that the king's power would not last forever and that God's kingdom is greater than every human kingdom. Daniel made sure God received the credit for the answer.

Then the king built a huge golden statue and commanded everyone to worship it. Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego refused because they would worship God alone. They were thrown into a blazing furnace, but God protected them. The king saw that they were not alone in the fire, and the three men came out unharmed.

These chapters show that following God can require courage when everyone around us is doing something different. Daniel and his friends did not know exactly how every situation would turn out, but they trusted God anyway. God showed that He is wise, powerful, present with His people, and ultimately in control even when earthly rulers seem powerful.
256.takeaway: We can choose what is right even when others choose differently because God is with us.
